subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should a workspace ignore file above 4 MiB silently and terminally exclude its entire subtree from all shared scans?
rationale: Bounding the read fixes a real availability hazard, but the selected fallback intentionally changes discovery for existing workspaces and establishes a new fixed-threshold policy that code review and CI cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve terminal fail closed
options.body: Accept the 4 MiB threshold and terminal subtree exclusion as the shared scanner contract, then merge after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Require a different oversize contract
options.body: Revise the threshold, diagnostic, or failure behavior before merge if silently hiding the subtree is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve terminal fail closed
recommendation.body: Accept the 4 MiB threshold and terminal subtree exclusion as the shared scanner contract, then merge after exact-head checks complete.
